cost_sensitivity.interpretation: The apparent aggregate efficiency gain is dominated by two evidence-free early stops, not broad retrieval efficiency.

planner_representation.interpretation: Basic facts were represented reliably, but category coverage was incomplete and schema validity did not prevent semantic violations.

executor_control.interpretation: The bottleneck is model control and evidence acquisition policy, not tool runtime failure. The frozen termination protocol also treats a blank no-tool response as a stop signal.

output_contract.interpretation: Three additional final responses were exactly offset by three schema failures.

semantic_feasibility.interpretation: Generating a valid envelope did not imply grounded, feasible, constraint-satisfying execution.

paired_case_diagnoses.evidence: CT-C finalized after 27 tool calls but omitted start/end on both airplane activities; environment micro also fell 72.7 to 53.6.
CT-C used 30 tools and finalized, but both airplane activities omitted required start/end; environment micro fell 64.3 to 31.8.
Both conditions reached 30 tools; CT-C also prefilled an unrequested sandbox attraction in the blueprint.
CT-C stopped after 28 tools and produced valid schema where CT-B exhausted 30, but environment micro was only 42.9 and logical micro 71.4.

CT-C round 0 returned whitespace and no tool calls. The frozen harness interpreted this as retrieval stop and forced no-tool finalization. The resulting schema-valid plan used 12,035 tokens but had environment micro 22.2, so this is not a grounded planning gain.
Both conditions used 30 tools without a final plan.
CT-C used 5 more tools and 103,690 more tokens; environment micro fell 78.6 to 74.1 and logical micro fell 87.5 to 75.0.
Both conditions used 30 tools and terminated without a final plan.
Both conditions exhausted 30 tools; no tool runtime errors occurred.
Both conditions exhausted 30 tools, and CT-C blueprint prefilled an unrequested sandbox attraction.
CT-C made zero tools and cut tokens sharply, but environment micro collapsed 78.6 to 9.1; blueprint also prefilled sandbox attractions.
CT-C stopped after 23 tools and achieved logical macro pass, but encoded taxi as an unsupported top-level activity and failed schema.

recommended_work: Manual case cards for the four delivery transitions, two zero-tool finals, and human split
Separate final-response rate, strict schema delivery, evidence-backed delivery, and All Pass in future reporting
